failed_or_abandoned: Zero-event treatment of the low-energy ROIs (XENON1T, XENONnT, PandaX-4T, SR1 below 100 keV) down to 5 keV: predicted 2.4-4.4 events at delta = 110-190 keV and drove kappa_hat to zero there, contradicting the published background-limited limits; replaced by a 100 keV true-energy floor (no change > 0.1% at delta >= 300 keV).

Future-exposure Asimov block first used the global (m, delta) maximum (10 TeV, 405 keV) mapped onto the 1 TeV grid (delta = 395, kappa_hat = 0), giving zero Asimov counts; replaced by the 1 TeV conditional maximum plus a Higgsino-point truth.

Count-based extrapolation of the PICO iodine limit beyond 366.8 keV abandoned (the curve's delta-slope is inconsistent with a fixed-count limit); curves extrapolated with their own log-slopes and flagged.
Region area alone as the shrinkage metric for null outcomes is ambiguous (region re-centres at lower delta and grows); kappa upper edge and delta range reported alongside.
